jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description: Join our investment team as a Data Analyst as we build a next-generation AI-enabled research and decision-support platform. You ll work alongside portfolio managers, analysts, and engineering teams to develop innovative solutions that connect research, investment, and portfolio data. This is an opportunity to experiment, move quickly, and shape the future of our technology in a collaborative, entrepreneurial environment. What You Will Do   Develop and execute investment data strategies to improve the accessibility, quality, and usability of research and portfolio information. Build and maintain data pipelines, databases, and data models that integrate information from multiple platforms, including Microsoft Fabric, SharePoint, and other internal systems. Use Python, SQL, and modern data engineering tools to automate data processing, analytics, and workflow optimization. Collaborate with data, technology, and AI engineering teams to integrate portfolio, trading, performance, and research data sources. Design AI-powered solutions that enable intelligent access to investment research, meeting notes, and decision-making history. Experiment with and implement emerging AI technologies, including large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, document processing, and AI agents. Develop practical applications, dashboards, and user-friendly tools that help investment professionals analyze data, monitor companies, and prepare for meetings. Rapidly prototype, test, and refine solutions based on user feedback, then transition successful concepts into scalable, production-ready applications. Partner with portfolio managers and analysts to identify opportunities for data and AI-driven improvements and translate business needs into technical solutions. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Home Surfaces
jobs.description: The Personalization team makes deciding what to play next easier and more enjoyable for every listener. From Blend to Discover Weekly, we're behind some of Spotify 's most-loved features. We built them by understanding the world of music and podcasts better than anyone else. Join us and you'll keep millions of users listening by making great recommendations to each and every one of them. Surfaces Moments is a ML team within the Personalization Mission focused on creating moment-based experiences across Spotify surfaces. The team owns and evolves the experiences that help listeners quickly connect with the content that matters most to them, including the Home Shortcuts experience and the underlying intelligence that powers it. By combining cutting-edge machine learning, recommendation systems, and product thinking, the team delivers highly relevant, personalized experiences to millions of listeners around the world. As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you will help shape the future of personalized discovery and engagement at Spotify. You'll work at the intersection of recommendation systems, large language models, and production-scale machine learning infrastructure to build experiences that delight users and drive meaningful impact. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys taking models from research to production, driving technical direction in ambiguous problem spaces, and solving complex personalization challenges at global scale. What You'll Do Own and improve the machine learning models and systems that power the Home feed, including the Shortcuts experience. Design, build, and ship personalized recommendations that serve millions of Spotify listeners globally. Build content recommendation systems for emerging agentic and AI-powered user experiences. Train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize large language models using techniques such as supervised fine-tuning (SFT), distillation, and parameter-efficient training approaches. jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Artist-First AI Music lab
jobs.description: The Music Mission team owns Spotify 's end to end proposition for music creators and the experiences they create for fans. The team is dedicated to building tools and services to enable creation, promotion, expression, and monetization at scale. We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join the Artist-First AI Music lab. Our team explores and advances generative technologies for music to create new experiences for fans and artists, with a focus on listening experiences that center and celebrate artists and creatives. All of our products will put artists and songwriters first, through these four principles: Partnerships with record labels, distributors, and music publishers: We'll develop new products for artists and fans through upfront agreements, not by asking for forgiveness later. Choice in participation: We recognize there's a wide range of views on use of generative music tools within the artistic community. Therefore, artists and rightsholders will choose if and how to participate to ensure the use of AI tools aligns with the values of the people behind the music. Fair compensation and new revenue: We will build products that create wholly new revenue streams for rightsholders, artists, and songwriters, ensuring they are properly compensated for uses of their work and transparently credited for their contributions. Artist-fan connection: AI tools we develop will not replace human artistry. They will give artists new ways to be creative and connect with fans. We will use our role as the place where more than 700 million people already come to listen to music every month to ensure that generative AI deepens artist-fan connections. For more information, see this press release: https://newsroom.spotify.com/2025-10-16/artist-first-ai-music-spotify-collaboration/ What You'll Do Lead foundational measurement and insights work for generative music experiences, developing the frameworks that help Spotify understand how creators, listeners, and rights holders engag

jobs.title: Associate Member of Trading Staff
jobs.description: Voleon is a technology company that applies state-of-the-art AI and machine learning techniques to real-world problems in finance. For nearly two decades, we have led our industry and worked at the frontier of applying AI/ML to investment management. We have become a multibillion-dollar asset manager, and we have ambitious goals for the future. Your colleagues will include internationally recognized experts in artificial intelligence and machine learning research as well as highly experienced finance and technology professionals. In addition to our enriching and collegial working environment, we offer highly competitive compensation and benefits packages, technology talks by our experts, a beautiful modern office, daily catered lunches, and more. The Trading Operations group at Voleon sits at the crossroads of finance and applied science, collaborating with research and other production staff to supervise and improve systematic trading strategies. The team ensures that the outputs of our research efforts are successfully implemented in the real world. Domains of contribution include algorithmic execution, securities lending, and market expertise across a variety of asset classes and markets. As an Associate Member of Trading Staff, you will rotate across our credit, equity, forex, and derivatives desks to learn each asset class and region we trade, and eventually assume ownership of our systematic trading programs. You will directly interact with both internal stakeholders and the broker dealer community. The collaboration and rotation amongst the team will enable you to become an expert in market microstructure and trading operations. Under mentorship from senior traders, you will build analytics and automation that enhance the level of sophistication and scale at which the firmwide trading program operates. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - NLP (m/f/d)
jobs.description: 🎤 Why voize? At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time: time to care, connect and be present. Our AI helps care professionals turn spoken notes into structured documentation, so they can spend less time on administrative work and more time with people. More than 200,000 care workers use voize. Join us to build technology that makes a difference in their daily work. 💡 Your mission Build agents that nurses can trust: accurate, fast and safe enough for real-world care. You’ll combine hands-on ML with thoughtful engineering and rigorous evaluation, using production data and feedback to improve the product. We’re hiring four ML engineers through one process. Depending on your strengths and interests, you’ll work on hospital documentation, US senior care, German care agents or the shared NLP platform. You’ll be part of the NLP chapter and work closely with product and engineering colleagues. 🚀 What you’ll do Build and improve LLM agent workflows for nursing forms, assessments, care reports and care-plan suggestions, working on tools, context, state and prompts. Own evaluation for your area: create benchmarks from production traces and synthetic scenarios, build regression tests and use results to inform what ships. Investigate real-world failures, reproduce issues across the app, backend and models, and turn what you learn into fixes, tests and data-labeling tasks. Train or adapt models where they outperform rented frontier models on quality, speed, cost or privacy—for example, for personal-data detection or smaller, faster models. Make latency, cost and privacy part of your engineering decisions, from model routing and caching to protecting sensitive data. Partner with product, engineering, data and customer-facing teams, and use feedback from care professionals to guide improvements. 🤝 What you bring Experience training, evaluating and shipping ML or NLP models to production, and explaining the decisions and results behind your work.
